name: Wendigo
ability: Bury a Town Card. If now there's at least 5 cards in the graveyard, also gain 2 fear. If 9 cards, also draw two cards. If 13, also inflict 2 suspicion. If 17, Inflict 2 more.

name: Mothman
ability: Pick a number. Bury all town cards with that cost, then based on the amount buried: (1,2) Gain 2 Fear, (3) Gain 4, (4) Inflict 5 Suspicion, (5) Inflict 8, (6) Inflict 10.

name: Flatwoods Monster
modifier: At the start of the game, shuffle the drone deck and place it face-down near the shop. Whenever a drone is buried, return it to the drone deck.
ability: Bury a Drone in your play area to: Draw 2 Cards, OR inflict 2 Suspicion, OR gain 3 Fear.

name: Loveland Frogman
modifier: At the start of the game, take your Magic Die and place it in a convenient location.
ability: Roll the die. If it lands on 1, self-inflict 2 Suspicion. 2-4, get that amount of Fear. 5-6, draw two cards.
